title: Experts disagree on delivery.json
context:
Chief architect: Both claims can hold at once and the build should honour both; it is ruled a pick only because a must-level security-auditor finding is part of it, so the owner confirms. Recommend limiting writes to state words, PR number, sha and CI verdict; atomic temp-file-plus-rename writes that never let an older reading win, and the Merge removal (a HUD-only claim that merely shares the target name), both still apply.

Target: delivery.json
- security-auditor: what the refresh writes is limited to state words, PR number, sha and CI verdict; no gh token, auth output, stderr text or PR body lands in delivery.json, the HUD snapshot or the HUD log
- integration-architect: the HUD timer refresh and the Stop-time saveDeliveryReading can write at the same moment, so every write is atomic (temp file plus rename) and a reading older than the stored one never overwrites it
- product-owner: the HUD stops promising a merge: no Merge node, no ready-to-merge words or glow; a merged PR shows only as a quiet rail note PR #N merged
